verdict.rationale: Square is API-first, so it can be driven without a UI. The Node/TypeScript SDK authenticates with a static token (`new SquareClient({ token })`), and personal access tokens are documented as fine for production use. A Sandbox environment supports non-production test runs, idempotency keys make automated retries safe, and the local MCP server runs headlessly via `npx square-mcp-server start` with env-var controls such as SANDBOX=true and DISALLOW_WRITES=true. Missing for 10: a dedicated official CLI, explicit CI/CD pipeline documentation, a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
